scope: Every proposed changed/new Git path and its UTF-8 content
JSON-decoded keys/values, escaped paths, Unicode NFKC and case variants
Known owner/host components from private originals and current local environment
Profile, home, AppData, drive and UNC paths; SIDs; keys/tokens/credential URLs; email/internal hosts/connection secrets
public_false_positive_policy: Public product-brand prose/comparison-fixture prefixes and unchanged shared Windows SDK tool paths manually reviewed; never whitelist complete owner/host identifiers. Existing public signing-certificate fingerprint is not a private key or credential; signing targets unchanged/unexecuted.
assurance: Pattern scan plus targeted review, not proof of absence of all secrets. Private originals, mapping, raw TRX/logs, baseline.json and caches excluded.
